story.title: AI's top startups are barely publishing their research

draft:
I'm noticing a trend where top AI startups are prioritizing product development over publishing research. 
This shift is concerning as it limits the ability to learn from and build upon their findings. 
Key areas like transparency and accountability are being sacrificed for competitive advantage. 
What are the long-term implications of this trend for the AI community?
#AIresearch #startups #transparency
